descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

displayName: Clown's Game - Gamble for your life
display_name: Clown's Game - Gamble for your life
display_long_description:
Clown’s Game is a gambling-horror game.
You don’t use real money, but the fear is real.
You are trapped inside a twisted circus arena.
Fences surround you. There is no escape.

In front of you are two machines:

A slot machine where luck decides your fate

An ATM where you must deposit money to stay alive

Each round has a clear target.
You spin the slot machine to earn coins and try to reach the required amount.

Every target gives you three rounds.
For example, if the target is 80 coins, you must reach that amount within three spins and deposit it into the ATM.

Time is always against you.

Above you, a heavy hammer is tied to a rotating gear.
Every round, the gear moves closer to zero.

If the gear reaches zero and you fail to deposit the required money, the hammer strikes a bell.
The bell wakes the clown.

You hear laughter.
The clown approaches.
The game ends.

This is not just luck.
It is pressure, fear, and decision-making under stress.

Can you control your nerves, manage your money, and survive the clown’s game? 🎪🔔
